{
  "question": "For Iris Logic, what do the latest records show about export permits? Please resolve this specific point: The share of September licence applications approved and the median processing time for those decisions.",
  "gap": "The share of September licence applications approved and the median processing time for those decisions.",
  "passages": [
    "I treated the announcement as a starting point and followed the measurement boundary through the reporting period.

Iris's permit decision ledger lists 72 approvals from 90 September applications and a median decision time of 19 days, giving an 80% approval share.

Background to the observation: Iris reported an increase in export applications.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
